svg.title: LionDriver V-cycle by standard: ISO/SAE 21434
svg.desc: The V-cycle by standard, ISO/SAE 21434: 33 of 89 work products cite it. Concept and hazards 3 of 12; System requirements 2 of 4; System architecture 0 of 8; Hardware and software requirements 0 of 2; Detailed design 0 of 6; Vehicle validation 1 of 7; System verification 0 of 1; System integration 0 of 1; Hardware and software integration 0 of 4; Unit verification 1 of 1; Implementation 3 of 5; Management plans 7 of 15; Supporting processes 8 of 11; Traceability 1 of 1; Safety case 3 of 6; Operation and field 4 of 5.
svg.text: 33 of 89 work products cite ISO/SAE 21434 in the register (WP-M-00 §3). Each box: how many of its work products do, and which clauses; one block per work product.

A work product counts when its register row cites the standard. Citing a clause is not meeting it: status is shown on the V, and nothing here is assessed or accepted.

g.text: Terms: ASPICE Automotive SPICE, the process capability model · ISO International Organization for Standardization · PAS publicly available specification (ISO/PAS 8800 is the AI safety one) · SAE SAE International (formerly the Society of

Automotive Engineers) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
